_README: FORMAT EXAMPLE ONLY. Replace with the real Percy scripts, media and survey before launch. Upload with: npm run admin -- seed-content scripts/admin/sample-content.json

segments.title: Greeting
segments.content: Good morning, {name}! This is our very first morning check-in.

segments.title: Mood
segments.content: How are you feeling as you start your day?

replies.Pretty good: Love to hear it. Let's put that energy to good use.
replies.Okay: Okay is a perfectly fine place to start.
replies.A bit low: Thanks for being honest with me. Small kind acts can lift our own mood too.

segments.title: Video intro
segments.content: Here is a short video about why small acts of kindness matter. It will be saved in your Library.

segments.title: Plan
segments.content: What is one small kind thing you could do for someone today?
segments.placeholder: e.g. Hold the door, text a friend
segments.reply: That's a great plan. I'll check in with you tonight to hear how it went.

segments.title: Greeting
segments.content: Good evening, {name}. Let's take a moment to look back on today.

segments.title: Did it
segments.content: Did you get a chance to do your kind act today?

replies.Not yet: That's okay. Tomorrow is a fresh chance.

segments.title: Reflect
segments.content: In a sentence or two, what stood out to you today?

segments.title: Audio
segments.content: Here is a short audio to help you wind down.

segments.title: Survey nudge
segments.content: Before bed, please complete your evening reflection on the Home screen. See you tomorrow morning!

why-kindness-matters.title: Why small acts of kindness matter
why-kindness-matters.description: How small changes in how we treat others can boost well-being, health and relationships.

week1-tip.title: Tip: start small
week1-tip.body: The most lasting changes start small. A two-minute act of kindness you actually do beats a grand plan you never get to.

weekly.instructions: REPLACE with your validated prosociality measure. Think about the past seven days. How often did you do each of the following?

items.text: Helped someone with a task or errand
Listened to someone who needed to talk
Shared something of mine with another person
Reached out to check on someone
Did something kind for a stranger
